page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred; handwritten ownership notes above and below the text are not printed and are left out.
page.notes: Title page with a printer's device (a tree between a star and a crescent moon) at the foot; no page number, running head or signature. Handwritten ownership inscriptions in brown ink at top ("sum Io. Iacobi Dietbuchepи" struck through, and "1.") and below the imprint ("Ex libris Joannis Jacobi Dietbuchii" struck through) are manuscript and are not transcribed. Some words in the title are set in mixed type (e.g. "Iohānis Frisiŋ", "QVAE" with a Q-like initial) and are copied as printed.
